origin: floor point between the four paws (0,0,0); scene root node identity
physical_dimensions_note: No measured source: no animal bones survive at Brezice and no dog remains were consulted; size is an R 'medium generic dog' design value.

models.role: medium-sized generic domestic dog (R), rigged, ten in-place clips (eight required + sit_idle, sit_up); origin on the floor between the paws, +Z front
models.export_bounds_note: rest/bind pose from the POSITION accessor (height = ear tips); animated envelopes per clip are in checks/glb_inspect.json (animated_bounds_m)

design_dimensions_R.note: medium-sized generic dog; no breed, no measured source

skeleton.naming: ANIMAL-001 quadruped scheme: root (non-deforming, never animated), pelvis, spine1, spine2, neck, head, tail1, tail2, leg_{FL,FR,HL,HR}_{1,2,3} (upper / middle / lower = pastern or metatarsus) plus leg_*_4 = paw (new for the dog, keeps a planted paw flat); F/H = front/hind, L/R = dog's left (+X) / right (-X); no jaw or ear bones

anchor_notes.base_center: exported node on the root (identity, floor point between the paws)
anchor_notes.head_lead: exported node on bone 'neck' at the top of the neck (collar / lead attachment point, same name as the ANIMAL-001 lead anchor); Godot imports it as Skeleton3D/neck (BoneAttachment3D)/head_lead; world rotation is identity at rest

animations.name: idle
animations.behaviour: standing on four planted paws; breathing, look-around head turn, relaxed tail wag (3 wags per loop)

animations.name: walk
animations.behaviour: in-place lateral-sequence walk (HL, FL, HR, FR at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 of a stride), duty 0.60, one stride cycle per 0.5 s loop (stride 0.60 m); planted paws move back at the authored 1.2 m/s

animations.name: trot
animations.behaviour: in-place diagonal trot (FL+HR, then FR+HL), duty 0.44 with a short suspension, one stride cycle per 0.4 s loop (stride 1.00 m); planted paws move back at the authored 2.5 m/s; head carried lower, tail raised

animations.name: sit
animations.behaviour: stand -> hindquarters fold (hocks to the floor, front legs stay planted) -> seated; ends on sit_idle frame 0

animations.name: sit_idle
animations.behaviour: seated: rump and hocks on the floor, front legs straight, breathing and look-around; tail resting on the floor

animations.name: sit_up
animations.behaviour: seated -> standing (hindquarters rise, front legs planted); ends on idle frame 0

animations.name: lie_down
animations.behaviour: stand -> sit -> front legs slide forward and the chest lowers -> sternal ('sphinx') lying; ends on lie_idle frame 0

animations.name: lie_idle
animations.behaviour: sternal lying: belly, forearms and hocks on the floor, head up; breathing, slow look-around

animations.name: stand_up
animations.behaviour: lying -> front legs push up into a sit -> hindquarters rise -> standing (front end first); ends on idle frame 0

animations.name: sniff_ground
animations.behaviour: nose to the ground (muzzle >= ~12 mm above the floor at its lowest), front legs slightly flexed, four sniff pulses and a slow side-to-side sweep per loop, tail raised with a slow wag; paws planted

coat_variants.selection: same GLB + same atlas; set StandardMaterial3D.uv1_offset = (0.25 * k, 0, 0) on a duplicate of the imported material (k = 0..3)

kit_unique_textures.name: dog_atlas
kit_unique_textures.layout: 4 coat columns x 64 px; rows 0-159 coat gradient (back -> belly / legs), rows 160-255 four 16 px detail cells (points, dark nose/eye/pads, inner ear, muzzle)

village_demo_still.note: plus PERSON r002, 6 ANIMAL-001 sheep, HOUSE, POT fixtures (not part of this kit); each demo dog duplicates the material only to set a coat uv1_offset

deviations: Proposal brief, not a frozen pack: executed under the opus-v2 COMMON/RETURN contract; the repository intake tool does not know this ID, so independent measurements are supplied in checks/ instead (tool not edited)
Two extra clips beyond the brief: sit_idle (seated loop) and sit_up (sit -> stand), so that the one-shot 'sit' can be held and left without a pop
Paw bones leg_*_4 added to the ANIMAL-001 naming (24 bones in total, at the <= 24 limit); tail has 2 bones (tail1, tail2); no jaw or ear bones
Keys at 60 fps (ANIMAL-001 used 30 fps) so that the 2.5 m/s trot stays within 1 mm of the floor between keys
Demo villager: MILK-001 person_herding is not merged (branch art/milk-001-r001 only), so the accepted PERSON-001 r002 (walk / idle) is used
Preview sun uses shadow_bias 0.2 / normal_bias 4.0 like ANIMAL-001 (renderer setting, not part of the asset)
